title: Recording stops silently — persistent alert absent on browser internet-loss test
context: Session uk_965ca53f20dc416aaa58370821a5cafe, 12 October test. Wi-Fi was disabled for approximately 60 seconds during an active recording. Only a brief 'Connection failed: timeout' notification appeared in the top-right corner. The required centre-screen persistent recording-stopped alert did not appear, and no indication was given that recording had actually stopped.
expected: When recording or transcription has stopped and cannot promptly recover, a prominent persistent alert must appear within a few seconds. The alert must remain visible until the interruption is resolved. The microphone indicator must not continue to appear live.

title: Frozen pre-GP SNOMED suggestion state is not persisted
services: annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
context: For session uk_012a93bbc39f4ff7907a587aad97d11f, the pre-GP UI displayed 20 extracted concepts and SNOMED code candidates. The frozen export supplied by the backend stores SNOMED-CT CODES = null and explicitly states that no SNOMED-CT codes were stored on the initial/pre-edit snapshot.
expected: Before any GP coding interaction, the complete original SNOMED state — detected concept, suggested/closest match term, SNOMED CT code, and candidate alternatives/ranking — must be persisted as an immutable snapshot linked to the consultation_id.

title: Annotated transcript original and final states are absent from session snapshots
services: annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
annotated transcript UI, copy icon, timestamps, survey, UK time
context: For session uk_012a93bbc39f4ff7907a587aad97d11f, neither the frozen pre-edit export (02-frozen-state-before-gp-edits.txt) nor the final post-save export (03-final-state-after-save-and-complete.txt) contains the annotated transcript. Both exports cover only SUMMARY, FOR PATIENT, SNOMED-CT CODES, and GP CONSULT TEMPLATES. A deliberate post-GP edit inserting 'I have a rash on my face' into the patient transcript was made, but neither the original nor the edited transcript state is present in any supplied export.

An edit/action trail or at minimum original/final timestamps must also be stored.

title: GP Consult Template snapshot stores only aggregate counts, not field-level state
services: annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
context: For session uk_012a93bbc39f4ff7907a587aad97d11f, the backend export explicitly states that the saved snapshot stores template completeness counts only, not the filled field text. Encounter-specific field values visible in the UI are therefore not reconstructable from the supplied snapshot.
expected: For each selected template, the snapshot must persist the template ID/version plus each field identifier, source/extracted value, status (captured/discussed nil/not discussed/manually added), and final value after GP edits. Aggregate counts may be derived for display but must not replace the underlying field-level state.

title: Final GP Consult Template snapshot does not match the saved UI state
services: annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
context: For session uk_012a93bbc39f4ff7907a587aad97d11f, the observed UI sequence was: frozen pre-edit = 9/22; GP enters Weight/BMI = 100kg; after saving, the UI shows 10/22 with the Weight/BMI value highlighted as an added field. The final database export reports 9/22, Not discussed = 13, and Manually added = 0, contradicting the saved UI state.
expected: After all template edits are saved, the final snapshot must reflect the same field count, field values, and manually-added count as the saved UI state. The final snapshot must be created only after all saved template edits are committed to the database.

title: Final SNOMED export preserves only accepted codes; full coding action state is not stored
services: annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
context: For session uk_012a93bbc39f4ff7907a587aad97d11f, the final export contains only the four accepted codes (Fatigue 84229001, Polyuria 28442001, Primary polydipsia 82800008, Unintentional weight loss 448765001). title: For Patient prompt contains conflicting instructions that produce unsupported advice
services: annotated transcript pipeline, clinical summary persistence, Save & complete, evaluation snapshots
context: For session uk_012a93bbc39f4ff7907a587aad97d11f, the system prompt instructs the model not to add advice absent from the clinical note, but the user prompt instructs the model to insert a generic 'If you feel significantly worse … contact the surgery or call 111' message when no red flags were discussed. That fallback text appears in the frozen patient summary even though it is not present in the clinical Summary, confirming the conflicting instruction is active.
expected: The patient-facing summary must be based exclusively on the clinical note/consultation content. The conflicting instruction must be removed or explicitly reconciled so that no advice absent from the clinical note is inserted. The corrected prompt must be versioned and its immutable prompt ID/hash linked to every evaluation consultation.
